name: Comment drop
description: A call to action. A big keyword drops in letter by letter over an empty comment box, falls into it and types itself, and it posts as your pinned comment. A viewer's reply with the keyword drops in under it, hearts fill and likes tick up. Sticker captions stack up near the hands.
when: At the end, for a 'comment KEYWORD to get it' ask.
needs: the rest of the pinned comment
the sticker captions with their times
a round photo of the speaker (avatar.png)
the cut time where it starts
